notes.title: Full Game Release Date
notes.notes:
[h2]We are happy to announce that our game is ready for Full Release!!! [/h2]

[h3]On the 10th of July you can play it in full version.[/h3]
After months of polishing, implementing mechanics and adding some new feedback players features we are sure you would like it - now we have 87% positive reviews on the game page on Steam. 

[h3]Besides the content which you have in Early Access, 
in the full game you will get:[/h3][olist]
[*] Complete story (9 chapters instead of 8 available)
[*] Added in-game collectibles at all levels
[*] Enemies activate the melee system when the player approaches
[/olist]
[previewyoutube=2ORkdzsC5qI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update by the community request #19
notes.notes:
[h3]One of the most long-standing and frequent requests of our players was the ability to skip dialog boxes manually. Finally, we have the opportunity to satisfy this request. It took us three weeks to implement this system and we are happy to present it to you![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34919535/df3fd2a3c1d1cbff1ed367ee62c0579b9209beff.png[/img]

[h3]Now you will need to scroll through each phrase yourself after reading it (except of cutscenes and some NPC phrases).[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34919535/d3789c9082b46df11909f66a0f11c60102026602.jpg[/img]

[h3]We also added the option to choose the size of the dialog box in the settings menu - the usual size or twice as large. We did this for players with poor eyesight, for those who have a small screen resolution and for playing at a distance. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34919535/3700b3634bbf74041c34a0903d3b4859f6e66786.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other fixes:[/h1]
[h3]In the levels with the ruins of the temple and the road to the camp in the 8th Chapter, the forest background is replaced with a more suitable and atmospheric one.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34919535/fcfd19f3784f6dee90c60327061b174bd9625705.jpg[/img]

[h3]Also fixed some text errors and bugs with shooting, crouching and grenades in Vietcong tunnels and some other bugs.[/h3]

[h3][b]WARNING![/b] To make the update works well - please don't load last save. Just go to the chapters menu and restart the current chapter otherwise you can get some bugs.[/h3]

P.S. If you found some bug - please let us know [url=steamcommunity.com/app/1059230/discussions/0/3356799628310475188/]here[/url] and we will try to fix it. Thanks!
